newsitem.title: FRANCE: TAT European airlines pilots call strike.
newsitem.headline: TAT European airlines pilots call strike.

text.p: TAT European Airlines, a unit of British Airways Plc, said on Thursday that its pilots and ground staff had decided to call a one day strike on Friday March 28.

The strike is aimed at the April 1 opening of French skies to full competition and to protest against changes in working conditions which the company said where "an absolute necessity to adapt to the new conditions of competition."
TAT said the strike would lead to big disturbances on its network, with the expection of flights to on Figari in the south of Corsica.
TAT earlier this year took over the airline Air Liberte from banckruptcy protection ain a deal with Banque Rivaud.
